# MikeDorian375.github.io

Agent-ready landing site for the Echo Sentiment API — a pay-per-call sentiment analysis API and MCP server built on the x402 payment standard (dual-chain: Base + Solana, USDC, no API keys).

## For AI agents

- /llms.txt — service summary + endpoint list
- /openapi.json — machine-readable spec (live)
- /.well-known/x402 — payment discovery (live)
- /robots.txt — content signals (search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no)
- /sitemap.xml

## Links

- Live API: https://api.6766587364.lol/
- MCP server repo: https://github.com/MikeDorian375/echo-sentiment-mcp
- Seller starter kit: https://github.com/MikeDorian375/x402-paywall-starter
- x402 standard: https://x402.org
